items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: the trio was Mike Mainieri on vibes and a then bass player named Johnny Morris... And we put together a lot of things.

ctx.x: And Sam Most, that’s a name I like to see.

Yeah. Sam was, well when I got out of school, one of the first things I did after graduating from architecture was get a job in a club in the Bronx, a little bar and grill called the Capri. And the trio was Mike Mainieri on vibes and a then bass player named Johnny Morris, who is also a wonderful pianist. And we put together a lot of things. Mike and I got together and rehearsed a lot of complicated lines, somewhat like Red Norvo and Tal Farlow years before. And so we had these wonderful arrangements. And we…
How big a group was that?
